newsitem.title: USA: Daou Systems cuts IPO by more than half.
newsitem.headline: Daou Systems cuts IPO by more than half.

text.p: Daou Systems Inc now expects to raise roughly $18 million from its proposed initial public offering, down sharply from an earlier filing, when it estimated it would raise $50 million in its IPO.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Daou now estimates it will sell 2.0 million shares for $9 each. It filed in late January for an offering of 3.85 million shares for between $12 and $14.

The company makes computer networking systems for healthcare provider organizations. Its shares are due to price later today, according to lead underwriter Alex Brown & Sons Inc, for trading on Thursday.
